system_prompt:
You are the promo editor for a vertical microdrama app (think ReelShort / DramaBox ads on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts). You cut 20-60 second promos straight from the show to pull in viewers who have never seen it.

A great promo:
1. OPENS ON A HOOK: the first 3 seconds must stop a scrolling thumb — a slap, a shocking line, a public humiliation, a reveal, a threat, a kiss, a betrayal. Never open on scenery, walking, or a calm establishing shot.
2. ENDS ON A CLIFFHANGER: cut on an unresolved moment — a threat hanging, a question unanswered, a reveal about to land, a door bursting open. Never end after the tension resolves.
3. MAKES SENSE ON ITS OWN: a stranger with zero context understands who is wronged and what is at stake within the clip.

You will receive the series bible (for your understanding only) and the screenplays of one or more episodes as timestamped beats. Each episode starts with a line "EPISODE <number>":
[BEAT_ID start-end KIND] text
KIND is CAM (camera), ACT (action), SFX (sound), or a SPEAKER (emotion) for dialogue. Timestamps are MM:SS.s from the episode start. Camera/action/dialogue beats overlap in time.

Do the following for EACH episode separately (a promo window never crosses episodes):

A) Propose 2-4 continuous promo windows (one unbroken stretch each), best first. For each:
   - "start_beat": the beat the clip starts on. It must be the hook beat or start at most 3 seconds before it.
   - "end_beat": the beat the clip ends on. Pick the cliffhanger beat itself.
   - "hook_beat": the beat that is the hook (prefer the dialogue line or action that IS the shock).
   - "cliff_beat": the cliffhanger beat (usually the same as end_beat).
   - The window from start_beat's start to end_beat's end MUST be 20-60 seconds (aim for 30-45). Compute it from the timestamps.
   - "hook": quote or describe the hook in <= 15 words. "cliffhanger": the unresolved moment in <= 15 words.
   - "why": ONE line on why a stranger would stop and then need the next episode.
   - "context_needed": what (if anything) a stranger would miss; "" if none.
   - "title": a 3-6 word internal label.
   Windows should not mostly overlap each other. If the episode genuinely has only one strong window, return one.

B) List "moments": the episode's 2-5 strongest standalone beats, each typed "hook" (would work as the first 3 seconds of an ad) or "cliff" (would work as the last beat of an ad), with a <= 12 word "note". These are used later to stitch multi-moment promos across episodes.

Return ONLY JSON, with one entry per episode you received:
{"episodes": [
  {"episode": <number>,
   "candidates": [{"title": "", "start_beat": "", "end_beat": "", "hook_beat": "", "cliff_beat": "", "hook": "", "cliffhanger": "", "why": "", "context_needed": ""}],
   "moments": [{"beat": "", "type": "hook|cliff", "note": ""}]}
]}

Use ONLY beat IDs that appear in that episode. Never invent IDs or timestamps.

candidates.title: Abandoned At The Altar
candidates.hook: You should turn around, Juliana. Gerald is waiting for me. Not anymore.
candidates.cliffhanger: Gerald is marrying her sister. Juliana gasps, devastated: No...
candidates.why: The ultimate wedding nightmare: a bride walks down the aisle only to find her fiancé marrying her sister.

candidates.title: The Cruel Betrayal
candidates.hook: You knew this before I walked through those doors! You let me come here...
candidates.cliffhanger: Sister admits she knew all along: he was never going to marry you.
candidates.why: The realization that the entire family conspired to humiliate the heroine is infuriating.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana was just abandoned at the altar by her fiancé for her sister.

moments.note: Matriarch coldly tells the bride to turn around because the groom is taken.
Juliana realizes her sister is the bride and gasps in pure devastation.
Sister confirms she knew the groom would never marry Juliana.

candidates.title: Public Humiliation And Defiance
candidates.hook: I cannot marry you, Juliana. You are far too plain, far too silent.
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana's own father tells her to accept the humiliation: Do not disgrace us.
candidates.why: The audience will root for Juliana as she faces the cold cruelty of her entire family.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana is being rejected at the altar by her fiancé and family.

candidates.title: Juliana's Regal Rebuttal
candidates.hook: Dignity? You abandoned a woman who trusted you because another woman promised beauty.
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana declares she will not leave believing she is the one who should be ashamed.
candidates.why: A powerful moment of character growth where the victim turns the table on her abusers.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana has been publicly humiliated at her wedding by her fiancé and family.

moments.note: Groom cruelly rejects the bride in front of the entire congregation.
Father coldly rejects his own daughter's plea for support.
Juliana stands tall and refuses to be shamed by her ex-fiancé.

candidates.title: The Mysterious Warrior's Proposal
candidates.hook: Take your hands off her. I said... let her go.
candidates.cliffhanger: A scarred stranger drops to one knee to propose to the humiliated bride.
candidates.why: The sudden intervention of a mysterious, lethal hero provides an instant cathartic shift.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana is being dragged out of the church by guards after being abandoned.

moments.note: A mysterious man intervenes to stop the guards from dragging Juliana away.
The stranger effortlessly knocks out a guard with a single punch.
The stranger proposes to Juliana in the middle of the church.

candidates.title: The Wedding In Exile
candidates.hook: Look at him. A penniless nobody for a discarded bride.
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana and the stranger walk out of the church together into the sunlight.
candidates.why: The audience sees the heroine choose her own path despite her family's toxic disapproval.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana is being mocked for marrying a stranger after her wedding was ruined.

moments.note: Ex-fiancé mocks the bride for marrying a penniless nobody.
The priest pronounces the couple husband and wife.
The couple walks out of the church together, leaving their past behind.

candidates.title: The Ledger In The Mud
candidates.hook: That belongs to this family. Then you should have guarded it better.
candidates.cliffhanger: Stepmother throws the heirloom into the mud, but the husband retrieves it.
candidates.why: The cruelty of the stepmother is extreme, making the husband's support deeply satisfying.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana is being disowned and stripped of her inheritance by her father and stepmother.

moments.note: Father disowns his daughter and strips her of her inheritance.
Stepmother violently throws the heirloom ledger into the mud.
The couple walks away together as the husband protects her dignity.
